name: nodejs-basics
description: Cloneable NestJS template: config, logger, telemetry, db, cache, kafka, jobs, idempotency, resilient HTTP client.

scripts.format: oxfmt scripts vitest.config.ts vite.app.config.ts stryker.config.mjs && pnpm -r format
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check scripts vitest.config.ts vite.app.config.ts stryker.config.mjs && pnpm -r format:check
scripts.check: pnpm lint:root && oxfmt --check scripts vitest.config.ts vite.app.config.ts stryker.config.mjs && pnpm -r check
scripts.clean:build: pnpm -r run clean:build && rm -rf .cover coverage-merged.lcov coverage-breakdown.json allure-results allure-report
scripts.allure:report: scripts/allure-meta.sh allure-results && allure generate --clean --single-file -o allure-report allure-results
